evidence.why: Signature, key construction, strict minimum scan, sentinel test, assertion and fallback return.

facts.rationale: Clarifies the exact sentinel contract without assuming unverified bounds on ranking fields or assertion runtime behavior.
facts.value: u8(MatchEnd*): a read-only-by-behavior selector returning the first human player index with the minimum ranking key, provided some human key is strictly below U16_MAX. The key is individual is_small_loser, plus the corresponding team is_small_loser shifted by eight only when is_teams == 1. If the U16_MAX sentinel remains unchanged, it executes HSD_ASSERT(178, 0), followed in source by return 0. Human presence alone does not establish the successful-return precondition.
